However, if a two-dimensional filter can be expressed as the product of two one-dimensional filters, the number of operations required for filtering can be reduced substantially. This is because applying a one-dimensional filter in one direction followed by another one-dimensional filter in the perpendicular direction achieves the same result as applying the full two-dimensional filter but with fewer calculations. Thus, the use of separable filters optimizes the processing time without compromising on the quality of the filtering effect.
